item.title: AI Governance and Decision Ownership
item.description: This episode explores the critical shift toward human accountability in enterprise AI, focusing on new California regulations and insurance industry changes. Experts discuss the 'Decision Owner' framework in senior housing and healthcare, emphasizing that while machines can advise, humans must remain the ultimate gatekeepers.
